title: Debug build panics on the fixtures: profile_idx <= profile_length in dp_matrix.rs:831
body:
With debug assertions on (any non-release build), this fails on dev at 837ba60:

nail search fixtures/query.hmm fixtures/target.fa --seeds fixtures/a.seeds --mmseqs-path /bin/true -t 1

Message: assertion failed: profile_idx <= self.profile_length, at libnail/src/align/structs/dp_matrix.rs:831, reached from libnail backward.rs via nail/src/pipeline/align_stage.rs:151. Release builds skip the assert and run to completion, writing 408 hits. Every seed in a.seeds has prf_end within its profile's LENG, so the seeds file is not the cause. Either the assert is wrong or backward indexes past the profile length.
